product_brief: A DNS service that supports post-quantum cryptography for securing client-server connections like DoT, DoH, and DoQ.
pqc_capability_description: AdGuard DNS supports client-side post-quantum cryptography using a hybrid encryption method called X25519MLKEM768. It combines the standard X25519 algorithm with the post-quantum ML-KEM768 algorithm. This feature is enabled by default in version 2.19 but requires connection through AdGuard apps (currently in testing via Nightly builds) as most OSes do not support it natively. It protects DNS traffic for DoT, DoH, and DoQ.
key_management_model: Hybrid encryption method using X25519 and ML-KEM768 for key exchange between client and server.
pqc_roadmap_details: Post-quantum cryptography is enabled by default in version 2.19. AdGuard VPN apps support is planned ("coming soon"). Apps are currently being tested via Nightly builds.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Requires connection through AdGuard apps; most OSes don't support it natively. Nightly builds may be unstable.

product_brief: Quantum-Safe SASE platform providing centralized visibility and enforcement for post-quantum cryptographic upgrades.
pqc_capability_description: Enforces TLS 1.3 with security level 4 cipher suites using post-quantum-cryptography-ready key establishment. Supports hybrid PQC handshakes combining classical and post-quantum mechanisms. Provides Quantum-Safe TLS Inspection (TLSi) for visibility into cryptographic posture, handshake verification, and policy enforcement for sensitive assets.
crypto_primitives: RSA, Elliptic-Curve Cryptography (ECC), AES-128, AES-256, SHA-1, ML-KEM (FIPS 203), ML-DSA (FIPS 204), SLH-DSA (FIPS 205)
key_management_model: Hybrid PQC handshake deriving session keys from both classical and post-quantum mechanisms within TLS sessions; policy-driven enforcement at the network layer.
architecture_type: Cloud-native SASE platform; inline encryptor/proxy at network layer for TLS inspection and enforcement.
regulatory_status: ISO 27001 Certified, SOC2 Approved, GDPR Compliant
pqc_roadmap_details: Gradual adoption starting with "crown jewels" (sensitive assets); hybrid phased migration aligning with NIST standards (FIPS 203, 204, 205); monitoring IETF TLS 1.4 drafts.
cryptographic_discovery_&_inventory: Quantum-Safe TLS Inspection (TLSi) provides visibility into cryptographic posture, detecting where PQC/hybrid/classical cryptography is used and verifying handshake negotiation.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Supports gradual, policy-driven adoption; maintains backward compatibility via hybrid handshakes; allows incremental rollout by source, destination, user, site, and application.
organizational_readiness: Requires CISO-led execution; involves inventorying cryptography, aligning vendors, and coordinating multi-year upgrades; emphasizes cryptographic agility and visibility.

pqc_support: Yes (tested post-quantum cryptography in an operational payment system)

product_brief: Quantum-resilient drones integrating Classic McEliece PQC to secure communications in contested operational environments.
pqc_capability_description: Successfully tested quantum-resilient drones integrating Classic McEliece post-quantum cryptography. This is the first airborne deployment of Classic McEliece, designed for DDIL environments. The system encrypts full-motion video, imagery, and flight metadata to protect against Harvest Now Decrypt Later attacks.

pqc_roadmap_details: Phased deployment across defence programs; additional field validation on systems in active theatres; extension to ground, maritime, and subsurface platforms.
testing_&_validation_methods: Successfully trialled at STV’s weapons testing facility in the Czech Republic; field validation in active theatres.
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Optimized for constrained environments; addresses Classic McEliece's large key size for airborne platforms in DDIL environments.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Phased integration; designed for immediate deployment; extends beyond aerial systems.
